No email address or phone number is present anywhere in the document
Gap between the Kotak Securities role ending April 2020 and the Prism Financial Services role starting October 2020
A long gap sits between the 2011 Cipla internship and the 2015 DataFlow role, partly covered by the MBBS (2010) and PGDM (2012) qualifications
The J.P. Morgan Securities entry lists three discrete short assignments (Sep'13, Dec'13, Nov'14) rather than continuous employment, so it cannot be treated as a normal tenure
